drug_information.description: Pseudoephedrine is a controlled precursor chemical subject to regulatory controls because of its potential use in the illicit manufacture of narcotic drugs and psychotropic substances.

applicable_ndps_sections.title: Controlled Substances
applicable_ndps_sections.applicability: Provides the regulatory framework for controlled substances notified by the Central Government.

applicable_ndps_sections.title: Punishment for Contravention of Orders Regarding Controlled Substances
applicable_ndps_sections.applicability: Applies to contravention of orders relating to controlled substances.

small_quantity.source: Not applicable. Controlled substances are not categorized using the narcotic-drug/psychotropic-substance small-quantity framework.

commercial_quantity.source: Not applicable. Controlled substances are not categorized using the narcotic-drug/psychotropic-substance commercial-quantity framework.

storage_guidelines: Store seized material in secure, appropriately labelled evidence containers.
Maintain evidence identification and movement records.
investigation_guidelines: Secure the seized material and relevant documentation.
Record container, package and batch identifiers.
Collect representative samples according to applicable procedures.
Send samples to an authorized forensic laboratory.
Document manufacturer, exporter and consignee information where relevant.
officer_precautions: Use appropriate PPE when handling unknown powders or pharmaceutical materials.
